project.name: backend-call-overlap
project.description: Vertical slice: GET /call-overlaps, a windowed+filtered "what calls (external and internal) happened in this time range" query for the dashboard's global scope. Depends on both backend-calls and backend-internal-calls to merge their two independent call histories into one flat list - the same session-cycles-shaped exception (a slice allowed to depend on more than one other) already grants session-cycles, since this module receives a full logged call from each and does something with it (extracts the minimal overlap-check fields) rather than coupling the two slices to each other. No containment/nesting logic lives here or anywhere in this module - that's entirely a frontend concern; this slice only returns the raw windowed, filtered candidates.
